title: Unsupervised Neural Operators for Rotating Relativistic Stars: High-Fidelity Equation of State Inference and Pulsar Spin Evolution at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.05790v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Observed populations of rotating neutron stars~(NSs) with millisecond-order periods are powerful probes of fundamental physics. Mass-radius measurements inform poorly constrained properties of degenerate nuclear matter, whereas high-fidelity population synthesis connects unknowns in NS formation and binary evolution to large radio-timing surveys. However, repeated structure calculations are prohibitive due to the computational cost of solving the highly coupled partial differential equations of axisymmetric general relativistic hydrostatic equilibrium that govern rotating NS interiors. Non-rotating calculations or approximate rotational corrections can bias equation of state inference and limit the fidelity of population synthesis in tracing the evolutionary history of progenitors and propagating equation of state uncertainties. In this \textit{Letter}, we develop physics-informed neural operators that can solve the axisymmetric proble

translated_title: 用于旋转相对论性恒星的无监督神经算子：高保真状态方程推断与大规模脉冲星自旋演化
translated_abstract: 观测到的具有毫秒级周期的旋转中子星群体是探测基础物理学的有力工具。质量-半径测量能够揭示简并核物质中约束不佳的性质，而高保真的恒星群体合成则将中子星形成与双星演化中的未知因素与大型射电计时巡天观测联系起来。然而，由于求解控制旋转中子星内部的轴对称广义相对论流体静力平衡高度耦合偏微分方程的计算成本极高，重复的结构计算难以实现。采用非旋转计算或近似旋转修正可能会使状态方程推断产生偏差，并限制群体合成在追踪前身天体演化历史以及传播状态方程不确定性方面的保真度。在这篇快报中，我们开发了物理信息驱动的神经算子，能够求解轴对称问题……
tldr: 该论文开发了物理信息驱动的无监督神经算子，能够高效求解旋转中子星的轴对称广义相对论流体静力平衡方程，从而实现高保真度的状态方程推断以及大规模的脉冲星自旋演化群体合成。
en_tdlr: This paper develops unsupervised physics-informed neural operators that efficiently solve the axisymmetric general relativistic hydrostatic equilibrium equations for rotating neutron stars, enabling high-fidelity equation of state inference and large-scale pulsar spin evolution population synthesis.
